messages:
sam: Heads up — during the narwhal-3q onboarding sweep we saw a spike in structured-response failures for the action contract. ~8% of requests that previously passed are now returning non-JSON or a stringified payload under "actions". Repro steps below and a sample response.
priya: ugh. did this start after quant sweep or after the sampling/determinism change? any example payloads?
sam: It coincided with the PTQ pass + enabling dynamic KV packing. Repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"narwhal-3q","prompt":"Invoke actions for user intent","max_tokens":200,"sampling":{ "temp":0.0 }}'
```
Sample bad response (truncated): 
```
{"id":"r1","output":"{\"actions\": "[\"create_ticket\", \"notify_team\"]"}"}
```
So the model is returning the actions array as an escaped string rather than a JSON array. Downstream parser fails and we hit retry budget.
lee: That looks like a decoder-side quoting issue. Could be tokenizer-level differences after PTQ causing extra escapes in early tokens. Any logs that show token stream or raw bytes?
sam: I attached minimal token-level dump to the canary job. Key observations: when KV prefix length > 64 tokens the first token of the array becomes a quote char (“) in a few runs. Ops-bot: Canary job 4412345678-narwhal-3q-onboard created. Status: running.
priya: Mitigations? We should avoid mass retries because that amplifies cost and creates downstream duplicates.
lee: Short-term: add a parsing rescue that detects a stringified JSON and attempts a safe parse. Eg: if actions is string and looks like JSON, run json.loads after unescaping. Also add a metric for "stringified_actions_count".
ev an: For rollout: block narwhal-3q on the dedicated pool and fall back to alcedo-v1-fp16 where contracts are stable until we root cause.
sam: Agree. Also we should run a golden-run diff between fp16 and 3q on the same prompt set. Priya can you kick a job to compute contract-compliance by prompt slice?
priya: On it. I'll run a 10k-sample sweep across the structured-output eval set and compare pass/fail rate + sample divergence, will upload results to the board.
lee: Longer term: add a model-level postprocess hook in the runtime that flags token-level anomalies (leading/trailing escaped sequences) and optionally trigger early restraint (e.g., force deterministic decode for contract-producing endpoints).
sam: One more note — observed the failure both with temp 0.0 and 0.2, so not purely sampling noise. Also reproduced with streaming and non-streaming.
priya: I'll also try a quick retrain of the last token head with a small bias to prefer raw array tokens instead of quoted versions, but that might take a day.
ev an: For incident tracking: filing a short P0 ticket and tagging infra + model-onboard. ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026, linked to canary job 4412345678.
sam: Thanks all — plan: 1) deploy rescue parser, 2) block narwhal-3q on production pools, 3) run golden-run sweep, 4) follow up with small head fine-tune. I'll post results here.
priya: Posted first sweep results: there is a 7.9% delta in contract pass rate between narwhal-3q and alcedo-v1-fp16; attaching top 10 failing prompts to the ticket.
lee: I'll add a linting step in the canary harness to fail the run early if stringified JSON appears in the contract field.
sam: Good. If anyone finds similar oddities on other models, please ping this thread.
priya: FYI added a quick snippet to rescue parser in the SDK (prototype): 
```
def rescue_actions(x):
    val = x.get('actions')
    if isinstance(val, str):
        try:
            # handle double-escaped payloads
            unescaped = val.encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
            parsed = json.loads(unescaped)
            return parsed
        except Exception:
            return None
    return val
```
lee: That will help short-term. Make sure to rate-limit retries and emit sample for the telemetry pipeline when rescue path used.
ev an: +1. I'll coordinate rollback knobs with infra.
sam: wrapping up — thanks. keeping thread for follow-ups and final golden-run artifacts. :thumbsup:
